name: AI Resume Analyzer
description: PDF and DOCX resume parsing with rule-based section scoring and Data Analyst skill-gap analysis.
summary: Uploaded documents are converted to text, checked for contact details and resume sections, and matched against a fixed Data Analyst skill profile. This implementation uses deterministic rules, not a trained AI model.
architecture: Flask accepts size-limited PDF or DOCX uploads under unique temporary filenames. Dedicated parser modules extract PDF pages or Word paragraphs and tables. Regex-based scoring and skill matching produce section feedback, matched and missing skills, and recommendations. Temporary uploads are removed after processing.

capabilities.name: Resume text extraction
capabilities.description: Extract readable text from PDF pages and DOCX paragraphs and tables.

capabilities.name: Rule-based resume scoring
capabilities.description: Check contact details, section headings, and content length against a fixed scoring rubric.

capabilities.name: Skill-gap assessment
capabilities.description: Match skill aliases against a predefined Data Analyst profile and suggest missing skills.

stack.usage: Coordinates extraction, regex scoring, skill aliases, result context, and temporary-file cleanup.
Accepts PDF/DOCX uploads with a 10 MB limit, handles parser errors, and renders analysis results.
Reads text from each readable PDF page; scanned PDFs without text require OCR outside this implementation.
Reads DOCX paragraphs and table cells into the analysis text.
Server-rendered templates present uploaded-file feedback, scores, skill gaps, and extracted text.

architectureConnections.description: PDF uploads are sent to the page-text extractor.
DOCX uploads are sent to paragraph and table extraction.
Extracted text feeds deterministic scoring and skill matching.

evidence.notes: Reviewed implementation files and repository structure during the repository audit. Only implemented behavior is recorded; availability does not imply production readiness.
